positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Continually improved the Playbooks tool for Sales and Service Hub. Contributed several major, highly requested features. Refactored the outdated codebase to use TypeScript, modern React patterns, and Apollo/GraphQL, improving performance while reducing tech debt. Mentored newer members of the team. Provided comprehensive code reviews. Efficiently resolved escalated user issues.
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · TypeScript · Apollo GraphQL

positions.title: General Manager
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Led a team of 15 providing exceptional customer service and premium, inclusive events at DC’s friendly local game store.

Notable accomplishments:
• Launched an ecommerce solution and shipping infrastructure in two weeks during pandemic lockdown
• Migrated to a modern, cloud-based point of sale and created custom integrations and reporting
• Developed a bespoke event management and reservation system
• Overhauled the wired and wireless networking and security camera systems during the store's expansion
• Attended trade shows to source new products, get event inspiration, and improve store operations
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · IT Infrastructure Management · Software Integration · Store Management

positions.title: Web Designer / Graphic Artist
positions.description: Designed and developed websites for small business clients with a focus on impactful branding and usability. Provided design consulting for independent web developers. Experienced with semantic HTML, CSS / Sass, Javascript / jQuery, and PHP, as well as Drupal configuration, theme creation, and custom module development.

positions.title: Actor / Singer
positions.description:
Professional actor and singer based in Washington, DC. Performed on stage and on street for several seasons at the Maryland Renaissance Festival. Former company member of Molotov Theatre Group.

Selected credits:
• Antonio in "The Tempest" (MD Renaissance Festival)
• Orlando in "As You Like It" (MD Renaissance Festival)
• Don John in "Much Ado About Nothing" (MD Renaissance Festival)
• Trevor, Ryan, Jared, zombiekillr14/Blake in "Neighborhood 3: Requisition of Doom" (Molotov Theatre Group)
• Trace in "The Margins" (Molotov Theatre Group)
• The Raven, Sante in "Nightfall with Edgar Allan Poe" (Molotov Theatre Group)
• Benvolio in "R+J: Star Cross'd Death Match" (LiveArtDC)
• John Calhoun, Black Fox in "Bloody Bloody Andrew Jackson" (The Highwood Theatre)
• Joseph in "One More Night" (1st Stage / Kennedy Center Page-to-Stage Festival)
• Billyboy in "A Clockwork Orange" (Scena Theatre)
• Oberon in "A Midsummer Night's Dream" (Maryland Renaissance Festival)
• Justin in "Gorgeous Raptors" (The Disreputables)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

• Revamped internal and customer-facing support systems:
  ◦ Created a custom remote administration dashboard
  ◦ Set up Parature support ticket system and integrated with existing systems
• Contributed to Acquia.com redesign
positions.insights: Skills: Drupal · PHP · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Software Integration
